en-GB.name: Jarvis
en-GB.summary: Talk to the J.A.R.V.I.S. core on your own TrueNAS server.
en-GB.description: A private skill for your own Echo devices. It sends what you say to your Jarvis core at jarvis.nas-server.co.uk and speaks its answer.
examplePhrases: Alexa, ask Jarvis how is the NAS doing
Alexa, ask Jarvis for my daily briefing

publishingInformation.testingInstructions: Private skill for the developer's own devices.
